claim.quote: We report new limits on spin-independent WIMP-nucleon interaction cross-section using 39.5 kg-days of data taken with a p-type point-contact germanium detector of 840 g fiducial mass at the Kuo-Sheng Reactor Neutrino Laboratory.

key_value_text.note: The paper states its limit as a plotted curve of the spin-independent WIMP-nucleon cross section against WIMP mass (Fig. 4) and gives no single number in the abstract or the text (the Fig. 3 inset only illustrates an allowed and an excluded cross section at 7 GeV), so `key_value` stays empty. The 39.5 kg-days ('39.5 kg-days of data', abstract) is the exposure behind the limit, now in `summary.technical`, not the limit; the record used it as its key value until 2026-10-29.
key_value_text.quote: Exclusion plot of spin-independent χN coupling at 90% confidence level, superimposed with the results from other benchmark experiments and CoGeNT with and without surface background subtraction.
key_value_text.value: 90% confidence level exclusion plot of the spin-independent WIMP-nucleon cross section versus WIMP mass (Fig. 4).

name: Limits on spin-independent couplings of WIMP dark matter with a p-type point-contact germanium detector

summary.plain: TEXONO analysed 39.5 kilogram-days of data from a kilogram-scale germanium detector and set new limits on light dark matter, after learning to separate genuine events in the crystal from surface noise.
summary.technical: 39.5 kg-days of data from a p-type point-contact germanium (840 g fiducial, 926 g crystal) in an NaI(Tl) anti-Compton and plastic-veto shield at 30 m.w.e.; bulk-surface event differentiation calibrated with gamma sources and an n-type point-contact detector; part of the cross-section versus WIMP-mass space implied by various experiments is probed and excluded, and the paper reports an order of magnitude improvement over the group's previous results.

title: Limits on spin-independent couplings of WIMP dark matter with a p-type point-contact germanium detector
why_it_matters: An independent germanium test of the CoGeNT low-mass region, from a different site and with a different background.
